verdict.rationale: xAI's API docs explicitly cover typed function/tool calling (define custom tools, model requests call, developer executes and returns result), plus built-in tools (web search, code execution, collections search, MCP), structured outputs with schema guarantees, and multi-agent/multi-step orchestration for agentic workflows. This gives strong first-party documentation for building an agent loop with typed definitions and parallel/multi-step calls, though there's no independent benchmark or hands-on confirmation of parallel tool-call fidelity, and some community feedback questions reliability/laziness in coding agent tasks (not tool-calling specifically). Missing for 10: independent verification of parallel tool-call correctness/reliability, and explicit documentation of parallel calls within a single turn.
